message: Quitting tobacco is one of the best things you can do for your health. Within 20 minutes, your heart rate drops. Within a year, your risk of a heart attack drops by half!
Feeling a craving? Try the 4 Ds: Delay for 10 minutes, Drink a glass of water, Deep breaths, and Do something else to distract yourself.
Tell your friends and family about your decision to quit. Their support can make a huge difference in your journey.
source: The Gambia Tobacco Cessation Clinical Guideline

message: Think about the money you'll save by not buying tobacco. You could use it for your family, your health, or something you've always wanted.
